message.content:
**Uno – Quick‑Start Rules** | Section | What Happens | |---------|--------------| | **Goal** | Be the first player to score 500 points (or whatever you agree on). Points are earned by being the first to finish each round. | | **Setup** | • 108‑card deck (standard Uno deck).
• Each player draws 7 cards.
• Place the remaining deck face‑down as the draw pile.
• Flip the top card of the draw pile to start the discard pile. If it’s an action card, follow its effect immediately. | | **Turn Order** | Clockwise (unless a Reverse card changes direction). | | **Playing a Card** | On your turn you may play **one** card that matches either the **color** or the **number/symbol** of the top discard.
• If you can’t play, you must draw one card from the draw pile.
• If that drawn card is playable, you may play it immediately; otherwise, your turn ends. | | **Action Cards** | • **Skip** – next player loses their turn.
• **Reverse** – changes play direction.
• **Draw Two (+2)** – next player draws two cards and loses their turn.
• **Wild** – you choose the new color.
• **Wild Draw Four (+4)** – you choose the new color; next player draws four cards and loses their turn. (Can only be played if you have no matching color; otherwise you risk a challenge.) | | **Wild Draw Four Challenge** | If a player believes the previous player illegally played a +4, they can challenge.
• The challenged player must show their hand.
• If they had a playable color card, the challenger draws 4 cards and the challenge fails.
• If they had no playable color card, the challenger draws 6 cards (4 for the +4 plus 2 penalty). | | **Calling “Uno”** | When you have **exactly one card left**, you must shout “UNO!” before the next player takes their turn.
• If you forget and another player points it out before the next turn starts, you must draw two cards as a penalty. | | **Winning a Round** | The first player to discard all their cards wins the round. | | **Scoring** | • Winner gets points equal to the sum of all cards remaining in opponents’ hands:
 – Number cards: face value.
 – Skip, Reverse, Draw Two: 20 points each.
 – Wild, Wild Draw Four: 50 points each.
• Play continues until someone reaches the target score (usually 500). | | **Optional Variations** | • **Stacking** – allow players to stack +2 or +4 cards instead of drawing.
• **No Wild Draw Four** – remove the +4 card entirely.
• **Speed** – play without calling “UNO”; last player to finish wins. | **Quick Tips** 1. **Keep track of colors** – try to hold onto a color that matches many of your cards. 2. **Use action cards strategically** – save a Skip or Reverse for when you’re about to win. 3. **Watch opponents’ “UNO” calls** – they’re a clue to how many cards they have left. 4. **Don’t forget to shout “UNO”** – it’s a simple but crucial rule. Enjoy the fast‑paced, colorful fun of Uno!
